subject: It's All about That Rebound
text: The requirement was reduced to 20+ successful shots, which is obtainable with any character.

evidence.quote: So I've dialed it back to 20+ shots which is obtainable with any character and still a bit on the tougher side.

subject: It's All about That Rebound
text: Jumping off without filling the jump meter and quickly discarding the ball barely allows 30 attempts.

evidence.quote: If you jump off the platform without filling any of your jump meter, get rid of the ball as fast as you can on your attempt and jump back up, you BARELY have enough time to get 30 of those "attempts" in.

subject: It's All about That Rebound
text: If every attempt must be made and converted, the most attempts possible is 24.

evidence.quote: If you're trying to make/convert each attempt, then the most you can get in is 24 attempts.

subject: It's All about That Rebound
text: Two characters whose favorite sport is basketball are ideal for this achievement.

evidence.quote: There are 2 characters whose favorite sport is basketball which is ideal for this.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: The bonus-round time requirement was raised from 25 to 35 seconds because 25 was too close to the wire.

evidence.quote: I pushed this back to 35 seconds based on similar thoughts from the 30 shots on the Aerial Challenges comment....But I think for only 10 points 25 seconds was way, way too close to the wire.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Bounce while clearing each vertical section of balls, constantly moving forward to the next.

evidence.quote: Basically, you want to try to bounce where your clearing each vertical section of balls as you go, where your are constantly moving forward.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Leave only a couple of balls in a line on each wall, then jump up into them while moving forward to the next.

evidence.quote: the way this one worked was you had to really work it out so there were only like a couple of balls left in a line on a wall and you had to jump up into them as you moved forward to the next one.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Players may get stopped in a vertical hang and must desperately recover their bounce momentum.

evidence.quote: you may not always bounce forward and end up getting stopped in a vertical hang, and having to desperately recover your bounce momentum.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: One player unlocked with save states and had 39.4 seconds left, showing some room for error.

evidence.quote: Even with save states, that's a challenging time requirement. I did unlock with 39.4 left on the clock with save states, so I guess you do have some slight room for error.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Practice or save states help learn ball positions and spacing between board sections.

evidence.quote: With practice or ideally save states, you better understand where balls are positioned, distance between ball board sections, and how your bouncing will go.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Board order is random, which matters at the start since you begin with 0 momentum.

evidence.quote: and there's RNG for what the board order is, which matters in the very beginning since you start with 0 momentum.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Each retry requires running through Basic Training first.

evidence.quote: since you have to run through basic training just to get another attempt in

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: The smallest board takes 2 swipes, and the big boards take at least 3 swipes.

evidence.quote: The smallest board can be done in 2 swipes pretty easily, the tall narrow board can be done in 2 swipes if it isn't the first board you encounter, but the big boards always take at least 3 swipes and often times 4.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: One player tried every character and their fastest time was 55 seconds.

evidence.quote: I have done a couple hours of attempts on this and tried every character, but the fastest I have gotten is 55 seconds.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: Character choice made no noticeable difference for this achievement.

evidence.quote: Unlike the aerial challenge, I didn't notice a difference in how the characters worked here.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: A commenter suggested rescoring this achievement as a 25-point achievement.

evidence.quote: Personally, I would rescore this as 25 point achievement honestly.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: A logic problem meant the achievement would not have triggered even when done right; the logic was changed.

evidence.quote: One, apparently there was a weird situation in the achievement anyway, so it wouldn't have worked even if you did it right.
